page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-16-lssd is a general-purpose, memory-expanded virtual machine powered by 64-bit Arm architecture. The instance allocates 16 dedicated arm64 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading, ensuring consistent compute execution across processing cores. Hardware acceleration via discrete GPUs is omitted, centering the compute profile entirely on efficient central processing and substantial memory density.

System memory is provisioned at 128 GB, establishing an elevated ratio of 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage performance is anchored by 1,611 GB of integrated local NVMe solid-state storage distributed across four physical drives. This direct-attached NVMe storage array provides high-throughput, low-latency access relative to standard network-attached storage disks, removing persistent I/O bottlenecks for intermediate data storage. Network provisioning includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating private networking or dedicated address allocation.

The deployment of Arm-based cores alongside high-capacity RAM and local NVMe SSDs produces favorable qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy and disk-dependent pipelines compared to traditional x86 alternatives. A primary technical tradeoff lies in the arm64 instruction set, which requires compatible application binaries and dependencies. The server is well matched for memory-intensive databases, transactional key-value stores, distributed analytics, in-memory caching systems, and high-throughput data ingestion pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-16-lssd is an Arm-based virtual machine configured for memory-intensive and high-throughput I/O applications. Built on 64-bit Arm architecture, the system provides 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128 GB of RAM, offering an elevated 8 GB per core memory profile. Local I/O demands are handled by an integrated 1,611 GB NVMe SSD array spread across four drives, delivering low-latency local access for temporary or high-speed data operations. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By combining an efficient arm64 processor design with abundant memory density and bundled high-speed NVMe storage, this configuration yields strong qualitative operational efficiency for compute and I/O tasks. The c4a-highmem-16-lssd is well matched for in-memory caching platforms, transactional database engines, real-time analytics, and data transformation workloads requiring high memory capacity and direct disk access.
